hero_text: Sunshine Academy is a nonprofit tutoring organization offering free academic support to students from 2-7th grade.
about_lead: Founded on the belief that education changes lives, Sunshine Academy is a community-powered nonprofit dedicated to giving students the tools, confidence, and support they need to reach their full potential.
mission_text: To provide free, high-quality tutoring and mentorship that empowers every student to succeed academically and beyond.
vision_text: A community where every child, regardless of circumstance, has access to the educational support they deserve.
values_text: Compassion, equity, patience, and perseverance guide everything we do, from one-on-one sessions to group workshops.
